description: B1 refrigerant charge basis and B4 replacement constants

chargeBenchmark_kg_per_m2.reference: LITERATURE ASSUMPTION - not a formal standard.
chargeBenchmark_kg_per_m2.gap: Refrigerant charge scales with cooling capacity (kW), not floor area. Charge priority: actual kg > capacity_kW x ~0.3 kg/kW (CIBSE TM65) > this per-m2 screen. Update when HVAC design is available.

chargePerKW_kg.reference: CIBSE TM65 - refrigerant charge per kW cooling capacity

hvacServiceLife_years.reference: CIBSE Guide M / RICS-BCIS - HVAC/chiller service life

eolLossRate.reference: IPCC - end-of-life refrigerant loss at equipment replacement (~15%)

deMinimisThreshold.reference: GHG Protocol / US EPA Corporate Climate Leadership - 5% de-minimis. INFO ONLY: nothing is auto-excluded.
